0.why: TrackerState.cpp:62-63 writes 10V while the timeline play mode is not stop, and 0V otherwise

1.why: TrackerState.cpp:64 writes 10V while the timeline's play trigger has time remaining, which TrackerControl.cpp:214 fires for 0.01 seconds

2.why: TrackerState.cpp:65 writes 10V while the timeline's stop trigger has time remaining, which TrackerControl.cpp:228 fires for 0.01 seconds

3.why: TrackerState.cpp:66 writes 10V while either the play or the stop trigger has time remaining

comment: The module declares no parameters at all, so the four output jacks are the only things on it that can be clicked. The pulses are 0.01 seconds long, fired by the timeline when play or stop is taken. How often the voice display is refreshed follows the Rate setting on the Tracker's own menu (TrackerState.cpp:40).
